description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_field' used within the SugarCRM framework, which retrieves the Smarty template equivalent for form fields based on provided parameters. It includes external dependencies, performs parameter validation, sets display parameters, and calls a method on a SugarFieldHandler instance to generate content.

classes.name: SugarFieldHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling different sugar field types and rendering the appropriate Smarty templates.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_field
methods.description: Main plugin function to generate Smarty template content for a sugar field based on parameters.
